svg.title: MMX mission profile: Earth to Phobos and back
svg.desc: An original independent mission infographic with the retrieved 2026–2027 outbound planning trajectory, schematic Mars capture and Phobos operations, two sample-collection techniques, and planned Earth return in 2031. All hardware sizes and later mission paths are illustrative.
svg.text: Earth to Phobos. Samples home to Earth.
Investigating the origin of Mars’s moons, from orbital surveys to samples in Earth laboratories.
Outbound: retrieved planning states • later flight: schematic

g.data-tip: Outbound cruise | 313 days, 7 h, 57 min of retrieved planning states, ending before the arrival-model splice.
g.title: Earth-to-Mars transfer
g.desc: JPL Horizons target −239, geometric states. 19 October 2026 21:00 UTC through 29 August 2027 04:57 UTC. No interpolation crosses the arrival-model discontinuity.

svg.text: Projected J2000 ecliptic plane • planet/body sizes enlarged
Mars-centered concept • not a reconstructed insertion sequence

g.data-tip: Mars capture | Retrograde burns capture the spacecraft, reshape and tilt its orbit, then match the Phobos orbital region. Paths are schematic.
g.title: Mars orbit insertion
g.desc: Conceptual sequence only. The displayed outbound ephemeris stops before a planning-arc splice and does not resolve these burns.

svg.text: orbits while both travel around Mars.
The Martian moon is the sample target—not Mars itself.
Illustrated flight hardware • not to scale
At Phobos: exploration + return modules together.
Propulsion module discarded after Mars capture.
Complementary sampling of the surface and subsurface
Total return target • two sites planned
Drive a hollow corer into regolith

g.data-tip: Coring sampler | A coring tube penetrates below the surface to collect material less altered by space weathering.
g.title: Coring sampler, C-SMP
g.desc: Arm-operated mechanical subsurface sampling; a hollow tube is driven approximately 2 cm into the surface, then retrieved and stored.

svg.text: Nitrogen jets at a landing foot

g.data-tip: Pneumatic sampler | Pressurized gas mobilizes surface grains and carries them through the sampler into a collection chamber.
g.title: Pneumatic sampler, P-SMP
g.desc: A gas pulse lifts surface regolith and carries it into a collection container, complementing the mechanical core.

svg.text: Data: JAXA / ISAS • JPL Horizons −239 • DE440s | Geometry beyond the outbound arc is schematic.
